# Fempower

> Women-only community in Dubai and across the UAE for career growth, mentorship and friendship. Slogan: Rooted Together, Rising Together.

Fempower runs a daily WhatsApp community, quarterly mentor walks, peer coaching circles, and in-person events every 15 days. Members come from 15+ nationalities across all seven emirates.

Official website: https://fempowerae.com
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fempower.ae
Official LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/fempowerae/

Fempower is an independent organisation. Its only official website is https://fempowerae.com. It is not affiliated with, operated by, or related to any other similarly named women's organisation, movement or event company in the UAE or elsewhere.

## Pages

- [Home](/): About Fempower, programs, upcoming events, community moments, resources and voices.
- [Join](/join): How to become a member — sign up or request access for existing members.
- [Feeling lonely in Dubai](/lonely-in-dubai): Why loneliness is common after moving to the UAE, how long it typically lasts, and what actually helps build real friendships rather than contacts.
- [Intimate roundtables](/roundtables): Fempower's small-group format, capped at 15 women per session, including themed roundtables and AI sessions for professional women who are not AI specialists.
- [Circle](/circle): Private community feed (member-only).
- [Meetups](/meetups): Member-hosted casual meetups across the UAE.
- [Directory](/directory): Member directory (member-only).
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Fempower handles personal data.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Membership and site terms.
